dataset: Open Guided Waves - dataset #1 (CFRP plate, 28 damage scenarios D1-D28)
source_page: https://openguidedwaves.de/downloads/ (OGW dataset #1 -> Guided wave basic measurement data)
notes: Legacy domain openguidedwaves.org is DEAD (NXDOMAIN via 8.8.8.8, 2026-10-03). The .de site is the live official host. FIBRE NextCloud is the primary storage; no checksums or download scripts are published by OGW.

structure.composition: 60 baseline (pristine, interleaved between damage insertions) + D1..D28 + multi-damage dirs D25_D28, D14_D25_D28
structure.per_dir: 12 HDF5 files pc_f{40..260 step 20}kHz.h5, ~13.9 MB each

h5_content.pitchcatch/catch: (66, 13108) float64, 66 one-way pitch-catch paths x 13108 samples @ 10 MHz (1.31 ms)

structure.plate: 500x500x2 mm CFRP, 12 PZT (T1-T6 y=470mm, T7-T12 y=30mm, x=50..450 step 80); damage = removable aluminium disc, 28 positions D1-D28 (7 clusters x 4)

license: free academic use with citation of Moll et al., Struct. Health Monit. 18(5-6) 1903-1914, 2019, DOI 10.1177/1475921718817169
